entities.name: José González García
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José González García is a Spanish-Mexican chess grandmaster, trainer, and writer. He earned the title of Grandmaster in 2005, becoming the fourth Mexican player to achieve this distinction. González García has represented Mexico in eight Chess Olympiads, seven times as a player and once as a coach. In recent years, he has also gained recognition as a content creator and online educator, producing instructional chess material and video courses for players of various levels.
